english.title: Foreigner fail to provide information to hotel keeper
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an alien of or over the age of 16 years staying at premises to which the Immigration (Hotel Records) Order 1972 applied, namely **(..SPECIFY HOTEL..), failed, without reasonable excuse, on

(A)_[arriving]_
(B)_[or before your departure from]_

there to inform the keeper of the premises of

(C)_[the number and place of issue of your passport, certificate of registration or other document establishing your identity and nationality.]_
(D)_[your next destination and, if known, your full address there.]_
english.legislation: Contrary to article 4(2) of the Immigration (Hotel Records) Order 1972 and section 26(1)(f) of the Immigration Act 1971.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Option B should be used in conjunction with option D.
(ii) The term 'alien' is used in the actual legislation and it would therefore be inappropriate to change the wording. However, in day to day speech the term 'foreign national' is more acceptable.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
